# Building Dart CLI applications

Curated by Skill Harbor — @dart-lang's official guide to building Dart command-line applications: process lifecycle and the thin-entrypoint pattern (never raw `exit()`), stdout/stderr routing and terminal capability detection (`NO_COLOR`), project scaffolding and executable mapping in pubspec.yaml, argument parsing and command routing with `package:args` (ArgParser, CommandRunner, type-safe accessors), native async stack traces, AOT-resilient subprocess spawning via `package:cli_util`, signal handling and terminal teardown, two-layer CLI testing (in-memory unit tests plus `test_process` integration tests), and modern distribution (`dart run`, `dart install`, `dart compile exe`) — with templates and an audit checklist. Honest caveats: Dart-ecosystem only; targets recent Dart (references Dart 3.12+); BSD-3-Clause licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
